summary: Set net/http.Request.Pattern (Go 1.23+) to the matched chi route pattern, with a build-tagged fallback for older Go and TinyGo.
test_command_note: The base revision predates upstream 9040e95 ("Fix flaky Throttle middleware test by synchronizing token usage"), so the middleware package's own suite carries a known timing flake (not observed in 6 local runs). One retry absorbs it; the held-out tests use httptest.NewRecorder and are deterministic, so a retry cannot turn a wrong implementation into a pass. The middleware suite takes about 25s.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream feature commit; that commit is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.scope_note: Upstream initially set r.Pattern from the per-router routePattern; nested subrouters were fixed later (818fdcf, #1089). The prompt therefore scopes the ticket to routes registered directly on the router, and the hidden tests do not exercise Mount/Route.
provenance.fail_mode_note: Request.Pattern exists in the Go 1.27 toolchain, so the hidden tests (build tag go1.23, like upstream's own test) compile at base and fail because the field stays empty.
provenance.size_note: about 5.4k non-test Go lines at base (including middleware)

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
